name: Viladasens (Spain)
description: Green field with a saltire throughout of yellow and red counterchanged.
history: The flag was approved on 2 June 1995 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2066 of 23 June 1995; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with a saltire throughout of yellow and red counterchanged, 1/10 of the diagonal wide.

features.role: saltire 1/10 of the diagonal, yellow and red counterchanged
